{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (sentinel value)
filtered_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of customers with valid age data
mean_age = filtered_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Confirm the count of valid entries
valid_count = len(filtered_df)

# Print results
mean_age, valid_count"}
